name: Gold surge + elevated VIX confirmed flight — short crypto only when the gold bid is a VERIFIED risk-off (not debasement)
rationale: MECHANISM: same Great-Decoupling fade, but adds the key disconfirmer as a HARD ENTRY GATE — require vix_level elevated ALONGSIDE the gold up-thrust so the gold bid is a VERIFIED risk-off flight, not a joint debasement/weak-dollar rally (where gold and crypto rise together and a short is backwards). When gold surges AND equity vol is elevated, the rotation into the true safe haven is real and crypto's digital-gold bid fails. Short crypto beta into that confirmed flight. Distinct from hh-macro-21 by the VIX confirmation gate (which directly neutralizes the joint-debasement failure mode) and by dropping the crypto-momentum leg. DISCONFIRMER: even a VIX-confirmed risk-off can see crypto and gold both bid if the shock is a dollar-debasement scare; kill if entries still cluster in joint up-moves. And a crypto short pays funding/borrow — the net-of-carry short edge must clear it, or the confirmed-flight signal is a mirage after costs.
catalyst: gold surge confirmed by elevated equity vol (verified flight to safety)
